text: You stand before a heavy iron door set into a crumbling stone wall.[p]A faint tripwire glints at ankle height across the threshold.
[Standalone check | Body DC 11 | NAT 20][p]Your body moves before your mind catches up. You clear the wire with a foot to spare and land in a low crouch, heart steady.
[Standalone check | Body DC 11 | Success][p]You catch the glint of wire in time and step over it, clean enough.
[Standalone check | Body DC 11 | Fail][p]You clip the wire. A loose stone crashes down from the lintel and grazes your shoulder. You stumble through.

options.text: > [Study the mechanism, since you see exactly how it works]
> [You already know what's on the other side. Step through.]
> [Force the lock, and break it if you have to]

text: [Body: High | no roll][p]You close both hands around the door frame and pull. The hinges groan, then tear free. The door comes away in your hands and you toss it aside.
[Choice check | Body DC 13 | NAT 20][p]Your shoulder hits the door like a ram. The frame explodes outward in a shower of splinters. You walk through without breaking stride.
[Choice check | Body DC 13 | Success][p]Three solid hits, and on the third the latch gives and the door grinds open.
[Choice check | Body | Fail][p]The door doesn't give, your shoulder aches, and the iron doesn't care.
[Choice check | Mind DC 12 | NAT 20, bonus_if stacked][p]The tumblers roll one by one without a sound. The door swings open before anyone could have heard a thing.
[Choice check | Mind DC 12 | Success, bonus_if stacked][p]Methodical turns and patient pressure, then a soft click as the lock opens.
[Choice check | Mind DC 12 | Fail][p]The pick catches on something and snaps off inside the keyhole. You're left holding half a tool.
[Mind: High | no roll][p]You run your eye over the lock plate. Simple three-tumbler construction, worn down with use. You know exactly what it would take to open it, and exactly how long.
[Choice check | Mind DC 10 | Success][p]You press your ear to the iron. Something breathes on the other side, slow and measured, and whatever it is has settled in to wait.
[Choice check | Mind DC 10 | Fail][p]You press your ear to the iron. Nothing you can make out, whether from silence or from listening the wrong way.
[Soul: High + scouted_door flag | all_of | no roll][p]You push the door open without hesitation, because you already knew it would give, and you already knew what was behind it.
[hide_if: picked | sets flag | option disappears after this][p]You work over the door carefully. Standard lock, worn hinges, no warding. The space beyond is still. You file it away.

options.text: > [Roll flat, pure luck with no ability score (DC 11)]

text: [HIGH tier roll | DC 15 | NAT 20][p]Whatever your best is, you just hit its ceiling, effortlessly.
[HIGH tier roll | DC 15 | Success][p]Your strongest stat carried you over the line.
[HIGH tier roll | DC 15 | Fail][p]Even your best wasn't enough this time.
[MID tier roll | DC 12 | Success][p]Average, but it got you there.
[MID tier roll | DC 12 | Fail][p]Middle-of-the-road wasn't quite enough.
[LOW tier roll | DC 8 | Success][p]Your worst stat scraped through, though the bar was low.
[LOW tier roll | DC 8 | Fail][p]Even an easy task trips you up where you're weakest.
[FLAT roll | DC 11 | Success][p]Pure luck, with the dice doing all the work.
[FLAT roll | DC 11 | Fail][p]Pure luck, and the dice weren't in your favor.
You turn your back on the door and walk.
